scope: Current outputs and work text artifacts enumerated with rg --hidden --no-ignore, plus all reachable Git blob versions for json/jsonl/csv/md/tex/py/yaml/yml/tsv/txt in the project common repository. New study, dependency directories, model weights/tokenizers, archives and binary files excluded.
search_keys: Every 1221 original English ID and exact complete question text in raw, JSON Unicode and JSON ASCII spellings; no labels or outcomes.
limitations: No assertion about external accounts, unreachable Git objects, unlisted files or pretraining exposure.
Literal complete-question exclusion does not exclude paraphrases, translated questions, shared facts or shared answer words.
